title: Nope. Hard pass on this one
text:
Nope. Hard pass on this one. We finally had cans to open to try this can opener out! Ha!

It looks okay out of the box. There are zero directions included. You might think none are needed, but this one could use it. It seemed like none of the ways we attached this to the can wanted to grab and open. We finally found a position that actually grabbed the can and cut.

It takes a hard grip to get this to turn. I mention it, because if you have arthritis, don't even consider this one. It will cause you misery.

Once we finally got the first can open, it ended up only halfway cut open. Can opener back on for another round around the can.

It cuts on the outer edge of the can. It does not leave a smooth edge. It made parts of the can look like it had been chewed open by a wild animal. The liquid in the can spilled on to the table as well.

As I am cleaning the can opener, I see that the cutting blade already has rough spots and nicks in it. After TWO cans. Two cans. Good grief.

I cannot in any way recommend this can opener. It is cheaply made, has cheap blades, and did a fairly bad job of opening cans. Save yourself the grief and buy a different one.
